container_subset: PNG signature; one IHDR declaring positive dimensions, bit depth 8, truecolor-with-alpha color type 6, compression/filter method 0 and interlace method 0; one sRGB; one or more contiguous IDAT; and one terminal IEND. No other chunks are accepted.
chunk_sequence: Every chunk length is bounds checked, every IEEE CRC-32 is verified over type+data, IDAT chunks are contiguous, IEND has zero length, and no byte may follow IEND. Unknown critical and all ancillary chunks other than the required sRGB declaration fail closed.
color_declaration: The required sRGB chunk is the sole color declaration. gAMA, cHRM, iCCP, sBIT, eXIf and every other ancillary chunk are rejected, including declarations that might appear equivalent. Decoding never consults a host ICC service.
rendering_intent: The one-byte sRGB rendering intent must be 0, 1, 2 or 3 and is reported in Result. It does not alter the normative sRGB EOTF used to create the linear working surface.
pixel_decode: Treat all contiguous IDAT payloads as one closed zlib stream: it must inflate to exactly height*(1+width*4) scanline bytes, reach zlib EOF/checksum, and leave no compressed trailing byte. Apply PNG filters None, Sub, Up, Average and Paeth byte-for-byte with RGBA bytes-per-pixel=4, checking cancellation per row and 32 KiB filter segment. The result is exact top-down, tightly packed straight RGBA8 matching IHDR; palette, grayscale, 16-bit and interlaced paths are outside this profile.
encoded_input_semantics: Decode borrows one complete encoded byte slice only for the call. The caller must keep it immutable until return; the same immutable slice may be read concurrently. Decode retains no alias, and Result binds the complete borrowed bytes with canonical SHA-256.
cancellation_semantics: Check cancellation before and throughout chunk/CRC validation, before lossless decode, through a context-aware bounded-read adapter, after decode, for every normalization row, before/after surface hashing, throughout encoded-byte hashing and immediately before returning Result. No partial Result or Surface is returned.
allocation_semantics: Before decode require width*height*20 + 2*(1 + width*4) <= MaxWorkingBytes. This covers one decoded RGBA8 frame, one RGBA16 normalization scratch frame, one immutable RGBA16 Surface, and the decoder's current/previous filtered RGBA8 scanlines. Caller-owned encoded bytes and bounded zlib bookkeeping are excluded.
excluded_responsibilities: Remote fetch, trust/asset authorization, animation/APNG, ICC, HDR, EXIF orientation, non-square pixel metadata, resize, crop, affine transform, frame selection, output conversion, encoding and muxing are outside this profile.
